name: hira_lump
desc: Make the puddle heave up into a thick, heavy, shapeless mound of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls rising from the middle of the puddle, like a body hunched and buried deep inside the goo, about to get up: tall and heavy, about 60 percent of a person's height, widening toward the top like hunched huge shoulders hidden deep inside, taller and broader than a bear-sized mound. The surface is only smooth lumpy goo with swelling bubbles, thick sagging layers, heavy drips and sticky strands running down into the puddle. Absolutely no muscles, no arms, no legs, no hands, no head, no face, no body lines or anatomy visible. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
